title: ehrharta undulata
intro: Ehrharta undulata, commonly known as wavewing grass or undulating button grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ehrharta undulata include its use as an expectorant to relieve coughs and as an anti-inflammatory to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
